projectsDir.description: Folder with one subfolder per project holding <name>/<name>.md. Relative to the config file; ~ is the home folder.

reposDir.description: Folder where project repos are cloned; a repo is matched by folder name unless the card sets repo.

transcriptsDir.description: Claude Code transcripts for the time split.

dbFile.description: SQLite file for uptime history and the digest log.

port.description: PORT in .env.local or the environment wins.

utcOffset.description: Time zone of card times and of the digest day. Defaults to the computer's offset at start.

readinessFile.description: File next to each card. {name} is replaced by the card name; with the flat layout a name without {name} turns readiness off.

ignore.description: Words; a project whose name or repo path contains one is never probed and its repo and transcripts are never read.

reviewAgents.description: Claude Code subagent types counted as review time.

command.description: Command that sends the digest; the text is appended as the last argument. Overrides Telegram.

env.description: Names of environment variables the digest command needs; npm run start:bg passes only these and a fixed list of system variables to the server.

cards.description: How project notes are found and read. Defaults: folder layout, Projium field names, ## Tasks.

layout.description: folder: <projectsDir>/<name>/<name>.md. flat: every .md note in projectsDir is a candidate; the file name is the project name.

recursive.description: flat only: also read notes in subfolders (hidden folders and node_modules are skipped).

filter.description: Only notes whose frontmatter matches every key count as projects, e.g. { "type": "client-project" } or { "tags": "project" }. Case-insensitive; list fields match when they contain a value; an array means any of. A matching note without a stage counts as development.

fields.description: Projium field -> the owner's frontmatter key, read and written there, e.g. { "stage": "status", "spec_at": "started" }. null turns a field off (not read, not written), e.g. { "site": null } stops uptime checks of a site key the notes already have.

repos.description: Project name -> repo folder relative to reposDir, an absolute path, or "none", for projects whose repo folder is named differently. A repo: key in the note wins.

name.description: flat only: name a project by its file name, its parent folder, or the note's first # heading.

stages.description: The owner's stage words -> Projium stages, case-insensitive, e.g. { "in progress": "development" }. When the dashboard sets a stage, the first owner word listed for it is written.

sections.description: Heading text (without ##) of the ## sections Projium reads.
